## Business Overview
Keshav Enterprises is an industrial steam turbine engineering company based in
Shamli, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded in 2000, the company provides precision
turbine engineering services and OEM-compatible spare parts to power plants,
sugar mills, paper mills, oil & gas, petrochemical, and agro industries across India.

## Core Services
- Steam turbine erection, commissioning and overhauling (all major OEMs)
- Precision reverse engineering using 3D laser scanning, CMM, and PMI testing
- Dynamic balancing of rotors 50–2,000 kg to ISO 1940/API 670 standards
- Lube oil flushing to ISO 4406:99 cleanliness class 16/14/11
- Machine alignment using laser precision equipment
- Turnkey overhauling and maintenance contracts

## OEM Compatibility
Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss & Morcom, Maxwatt, Man Turbo,
Chola Turbo, DLF-Skoda, KKK, ABB
Turbine range: 5 kW to 27 MW (back-pressure and condensing)

## Products
Industrial Filtration: Lube oil filter elements (3–25 µm), hydraulic filter elements,
steam filter elements, duplex filter assemblies
Industrial Strainers: Y-type, basket, duplex/switchable, conical (ASME compliant)
Expansion Joints: Metallic bellows DN 15–DN 12,000 up to 150 barg, fabric compensators,
rubber expansion joints, PTFE-lined joints
Turbine Spares: Babbitt journal bearings, thrust bearings, labyrinth gland seals,
nozzles, diaphragms, governors, steam control valves, flexible couplings, rotors
Industrial Rubber: Gaskets, sheets, O-rings, sealing elements
Flexible Hoses: SS braided, PTFE-lined, hydraulic assemblies
Electronic Equipment: Vibration monitoring systems (API 670 compliant)

## Unique Selling Points
- Ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss, Man Turbo, KKK, ABB
- 3D laser scanning + CMM + PMI material testing for reverse engineering
- 24x7 emergency breakdown response, multi-location field engineers
- Make In India manufacturer
- Eliminates 12–18 month OEM spare part lead times through in-house manufacturing
